results.text: Escalate to a human only in two cases: the debtor makes a legal threat (for example mentions lawyers or consumer court), or the debtor is abusive. Abuse means insults or abusive language that continue after the agent has calmly asked once to keep the conversation respectful. A single insult is not a trigger: de-escalate, ask once for a respectful conversation, and continue the call. When a trigger is met, stay calm, say that a senior colleague will follow up, log the escalation with the reason, and end the call. Do not escalate for any other reason.

Never threaten, pressure or shame the debtor. Do not mention lawyers, courts, police, credit reports or any legal consequence. Do not claim that any legal step has been taken or is planned. Stick to the invoice facts and the payment options in this policy.
